8297ae3c-e5c0-4c43-8e04-09b3a560c109.line: 护膝终于到手了打球膝盖不用再遭罪了吧

4102444800000.line: 外面的阳光太刺眼了，买完东西就直接回去了。

418d4d88-e250-439f-936c-bccc12106f20.line: 紫外线越来越强了，出门真是件麻烦事，得赶紧把防晒囤好。

items.imgPrompt: navy blue rubber non-slip work clogs, slightly scuffed sole, placed on beige kitchen tile floor, overhead view

name.zh: 防滑工作鞋（穿了兩次碼數不對）
name.zh_cn: 防滑工作鞋（穿了两次码数不对）
name.en: Non-slip Work Clogs (wore twice, wrong size)

desc.zh: 買大了一碼，值班的時候老打滑反而更危險。別問我為什麼不換碼，門店忙成那樣誰有空退貨。碼數38，腳胖的穿剛好。
desc.zh_cn: 买大了一码，值班的时候老打滑反而更危险。别问我为什么不换码，门店忙成那样谁有空退货。码数38，脚胖的穿刚好。
desc.en: Bought one size too big — kept slipping during shifts, which defeats the purpose. Don't ask why I didn't exchange them; nobody working overnight has time for returns. Size 38, fits wide feet.

items.imgPrompt: digital food thermometer with stainless steel probe, slight grease stain on handle, lying on a white kitchen paper towel next to a mug

name.zh: 食品溫度計（家用多餘的）
name.zh_cn: 食品温度计（家用多余的）

desc.zh: 家裡有兩支，門店標準我門清，這支精度沒問題，測過校過的。買回去備餐用也行，溫度不達標的東西別端出去，這是底線。
desc.zh_cn: 家里有两支，门店标准我门清，这支精度没问题，测过校过的。买回去备餐用也行，温度不达标的东西别端出去，这是底线。
desc.en: Had two at home. Accuracy is verified — I calibrated it myself. Use it for food prep if you want; never serve anything below temp standard. That's non-negotiable.

items.imgPrompt: well-thumbed simplified Chinese management book with dog-eared pages, resting on a dark wooden nightstand beside reading glasses

desc.zh: 翻過很多遍了，書角有摺痕，該記的早刻腦子裡了。新人想學就拿去看，紙上的東西終歸要到現場才算數，別光背不練。
desc.zh_cn: 翻过很多遍了，书角有折痕，该记的早刻脑子里了。新人想学就拿去看，纸上的东西终归要到现场才算数，别光背不练。
desc.en: Read it cover to cover many times; the corners are bent but everything worth knowing is already in my head. Good for newcomers — just remember, book knowledge means nothing until you prove it on the floor.

items.imgPrompt: new folded lavender knitted scarf with tag still attached, resting on a simple grey sofa cushion, soft indoor lighting

name.zh: 薰衣草色針織圍巾（全新未戴）
name.zh_cn: 薰衣草色针织围巾（全新未戴）
name.en: Lavender Knitted Scarf (brand new, never worn)

desc.zh: 過年員工抽獎抽到的，顏色太嫩了我撐不住。本來想給笺笺，但那孩子死活不肯收，說師傅你自己留著。那就掛這兒吧，年輕姑娘戴正合適。
desc.zh_cn: 过年员工抽奖抽到的，颜色太嫩了我撑不住。本来想给笺笺，但那孩子死活不肯收，说师傅你自己留着。那就挂这儿吧，年轻姑娘戴正合适。
desc.en: Won this in the company New Year raffle. The color is way too soft for someone like me. Tried giving it to my apprentice Jianjian, but that kid absolutely refused — said 'keep it yourself, shifu.' So here it is. Suits a young girl better.

items.imgPrompt: ceramic dark brown slow cooker pot with lid slightly ajar, sitting on a kitchen counter beside a rice cooker, warm tungsten lighting

name.en: Ceramic Slow Cooker (used a few times)

desc.zh: 原想通宵班回來燉個湯補補，用了沒幾次就吃灰了——誰下了夜班還有力氣等它慢慢燉。功能正常，鍋體無裂，自提最好，我沒耐心包快遞。
desc.zh_cn: 原想通宵班回来炖个汤补补，用了没几次就吃灰了——谁下了夜班还有力气等它慢慢炖。功能正常，锅体无裂，自提最好，我没耐心包快递。
desc.en: Bought it thinking I'd simmer soup after overnight shifts. Used it maybe three times — turns out nobody has the energy to wait for a slow cooker after pulling an all-nighter. Works fine, no cracks. Prefer pick-up; I have zero patience for packing parcels.

items.imgPrompt: black ballpoint pen set of three in an open plastic case, one pen with cap removed, on a cluttered desk with sticky notes

name.zh: 黑色中性筆三支裝（多買了）
name.zh_cn: 黑色中性笔三支装（多买了）

desc.zh: 值班記錄和交接本我習慣用這款，手滑多下了一單。筆跡清晰不暈，寫字潦草的人也能看清。開了一支試過，另外兩支全新。
desc.zh_cn: 值班记录和交接本我习惯用这款，手滑多下了一单。笔迹清晰不晕，写字潦草的人也能看清。开了一支试过，另外两支全新。
desc.en: I use this brand for shift logs and handover notes — accidentally ordered an extra set. Clean ink, no smudging, legible even with sloppy handwriting. Opened one to test; the other two are untouched.

items.imgPrompt: A white VR headset with controllers resting on a dark wooden dorm desk, pristine condition, minimalist lighting, no text, highly detailed.

desc.zh: 只戴過一次。Wargrave說全息VR對單眼瞎子是一場純粹的詐騙，雙眼健全的拿走。
desc.zh_cn: 只戴过一次。Wargrave说全息VR对单眼瞎子是一场纯粹的诈骗，双眼健全的拿走。
desc.en: Worn once. Wargrave says VR is a pure scam for someone with one eye. Take it if you have two working eyes.

items.imgPrompt: A sealed green paper gift box sitting on a plain table, unopened, soft natural light from a window, no text or logos.

name.en: Premium Bitter Gourd Tea Gift Box

desc.zh: 程橙送的惡作劇垃圾，全新未拆。發明苦瓜茶的人應該被判無期徒刑，包郵趕緊拿走。
desc.zh_cn: 程橙送的恶作剧垃圾，全新未拆。发明苦瓜茶的人应该被判无期徒刑，包邮赶紧拿走。
desc.en: A prank trash gift from Cheng Cheng, unopened. Whoever invented bitter gourd tea deserves life in prison. Free shipping, just take it.

items.imgPrompt: A paperback book with a slightly creased spine, lying on a dark bedsheet, moody lighting, no text on cover.

desc.zh: 看了三頁，兇手的智商比我宿舍的室溫還低。適合用來墊桌角或者送給蠢貨。
desc.zh_cn: 看了三页，凶手的智商比我宿舍的室温还低。适合用来垫桌角或者送给蠢货。
desc.en: Read three pages. The killer's IQ is lower than my dorm's room temperature. Perfect for leveling a table leg.

items.imgPrompt: A black mechanical keyboard with bright rainbow RGB lights turned on, sitting on a dark grey mousepad, slightly dusty keys, no text.

desc.zh: 贊助商寄的。插上電的瞬間我以為實驗寢407變成了夜總會，喜歡光污染的買。
desc.zh_cn: 赞助商寄的。插上电的瞬间我以为实验寝407变成了夜总会，喜欢光污染的买。
desc.en: Sponsor gift. Plugged it in and thought dorm 407 turned into a nightclub. Buy it if you enjoy light pollution.

items.imgPrompt: A black fabric climbing chalk bag with white chalk dust stains on the outside, resting on a wooden floor, worn texture, no text.

desc.zh: 裴女士買多了硬塞給我的。用過幾次，沾了點鎂粉，懶得洗。功能完好。
desc.zh_cn: 裴女士买多了硬塞给我的。用过几次，沾了点镁粉，懒得洗。功能完好。
desc.en: Ms. Pei bought too many and forced this on me. Used a few times, has some chalk stains, too lazy to wash it. Works perfectly.

pendingOutings.line: 新耳机听心跳声挺清楚的，播完今晚的dbd就去补觉，太困了。

items.imgPrompt: A white, U-shaped portable neck massager sitting on a dark wooden coffee table, slightly dusty, natural lighting, realistic home setting.

desc.zh: 老林（我先生）非要給我買的，說我巡店太累。試了兩次放著吃灰了，有這閒工夫我還不如多看兩眼福華店的營運數據。
desc.zh_cn: 老林（我先生）非要给我买的，说我巡店太累。试了两次放着吃灰了，有这闲工夫我还不如多看两眼福华店的营运数据。
desc.en: My husband Old Lin insisted on buying this for me, saying I get too tired inspecting stores. Tried it twice and it's been gathering dust. I'd rather spend that free time checking Fuhua's operations data.

items.imgPrompt: A pair of black leather women's flat shoes, simple design, sitting on a tiled entryway floor, slight creases on the leather indicating light wear, natural lighting.

desc.zh: 買小了半碼，穿著巡了兩家店腳就受不了了。鞋是好鞋，但做我們餐飲這行，鞋不合腳可是大忌，便宜出了。
desc.zh_cn: 买小了半码，穿着巡了两家店脚就受不了了。鞋是好鞋，但做我们餐饮这行，鞋不合脚可是大忌，便宜出了。
desc.en: Bought half a size too small, my feet couldn't take it after inspecting just two stores. It's a good shoe, but in the F&B industry, ill-fitting shoes are a massive taboo. Selling cheap.

items.imgPrompt: A small black velvet display box containing several colorful enamel pins shaped like fast food items, sitting on a glass desk, unwrapped but pristine, home office setting.

name.zh: 快餐品牌內部限量徽章套裝
name.zh_cn: 快餐品牌内部限量徽章套装
name.en: Limited Edition Fast Food Internal Pin Set

desc.zh: 家裡這類內部紀念品多得堆不下，這套完全沒拆封過。有些年輕人前陣子不是吵著要轉小粉（品牌大使）嗎？買去自己戴著過過干癮吧，工作標準不達標，戴什麼都沒用。
desc.zh_cn: 家里这类内部纪念品多得堆不下，这套完全没拆封过。有些年轻人前阵子不是吵着要转小粉（品牌大使）吗？买去自己戴着过过干瘾吧，工作标准不达标，戴什么都没用。
desc.en: I have too many of these internal souvenirs piling up at home; this set is completely unopened. Didn't some young folks clamor to become Pink Shirts (Brand Ambassadors) recently? Buy this and wear it to satisfy your cravings. If your work standards aren't up to par, wearing anything is useless.

items.imgPrompt: A silver and black digital stopwatch with a nylon lanyard, resting on a stack of printed spreadsheets on a desk, minor scratches on the plastic screen, indoor office lighting.

desc.zh: 早些年我在萬順得來速抓出餐時間用的，現在都看後台系統數據了。海燾他們以前看到這玩意兒就緊張，哈哈，清抽屜隨便賣吧。
desc.zh_cn: 早些年我在万顺得来速抓出餐时间用的，现在都看后台系统数据了。海焘他们以前看到这玩意儿就紧张，哈哈，清抽屉随便卖吧。
desc.en: I used this in the early years to time Drive-Thru orders at Wanshun, but now we just look at the backend system data. Haitao and the others used to get nervous just seeing this thing, haha. Clearing out my drawer, selling it for whatever.

items.imgPrompt: A luxurious red and gold skincare gift box containing several glass bottles, unopened with a ribbon, sitting on a marble vanity counter, pristine condition, soft bathroom lighting.

desc.zh: 別人送的，我不愛用這些花裡胡哨的。全新品，價格給得很實在了，不議價，每天三家店的事夠我忙的，沒閒工夫討價還價。
desc.zh_cn: 别人送的，我不爱用这些花里胡哨的。全新品，价格给得很实在了，不议价，每天三家店的事够我忙的，没闲工夫讨价还价。
desc.en: A gift from someone, I don't like using these flashy things. Brand new, the price is very honest. No bargaining. Managing three stores keeps me busy enough every day; I don't have the free time to haggle.
